title: Supplemental aggregate evidence map
purpose: Display non-facility utility, regulatory and planning evidence as geographic footprints where jurisdiction is public.
accounting: These are aggregate/source-level overlays. They are never treated as facilities and are not added to the core row count.

records.label: utility/regional footprint
records.notes: BC Hydro reports 15 AI/data-centre applications representing close to 800 MW total load request. Outside the nine-market core geography.

records.label: utility/regional footprint
records.notes: Alectra reports an undisclosed customer proposing a 108 MVA data center in Vaughan. MVA is retained as reported and is not converted to MW.

records.label: utility/regional footprint
records.notes: CELT 2026 lists a 200 MW data-center project in the NEMA load zone; it is forecast evidence and may overlap IRTT/other connection records.

records.label: organized-market/regional footprint
records.notes: MTEP25 reports 11.6 GW of large-load additions and 49 EPR requests. Planning aggregate; not an additional facility population.

records.label: organized-market/regional footprint
records.notes: MISO preliminary 2026 MTEP EPR data show 13.1 GW of large-load additions. This overlaps other MISO planning and queue aggregates.

records.provider: New York State Public Service Commission / NYISO
records.label: utility/regional footprint
records.notes: New York regulatory materials reported 48 future large-load projects totaling more than 11.9 GW in the NYISO queue as of February 2026. Current core NYISO rows are a later/different publication layer, so this is not additive.

records.label: utility/regional footprint
records.notes: IESO states the list covers all connection proposals that submitted an application package and executed the required agreement. The core registry separately filters its large-load subset.

records.label: utility/regional footprint
records.notes: OEB reports the CCIM contains about 6.9 million data points covering utility-provided load and DER capacity information. This is grid-context evidence, not facility count.

records.label: utility/regional footprint
records.notes: CAISO states utilities are receiving increasing large-load interconnection/service applications and publishes a dedicated Large Loads initiative. Current core CAISO data are Cluster 15 only.

records.label: utility/regional footprint
records.notes: SPP operates a dedicated High Impact Large Load framework covering data centers and other large loads, with public rules, stakeholder materials and associated study/service pathways.

records.label: utility/regional footprint
records.notes: Hydro-Québec reports nearly 200 MW of peak consumption by the sector, with consumption potentially reaching about 1,000 MW by 2035. New projects above 5 MW remain subject to its selection process. Outside the nine-market core geography.

records.label: utility/regional footprint
records.notes: Hydro-Québec reports approximately 115 MW of blockchain-sector consumption. Preserved as a separate large-compute demand signal, not treated as data-center capacity.

records.label: organized-market/regional footprint
records.notes: ERCOT publicly publishes Batch Zero forms, question reference guides and process/timeline material for large-load integration. The public page does not enumerate completed individual RFI responses, and RIOO submissions are controlling. Illustrative LLI-9001-style rows in an ERCOT demo update are not treated as real projects. No Batch Zero project rows are fabricated.

records.label: organized-market/regional footprint
records.notes: The 2026-09-24 LAS materials list large-load/data-center forecast submissions from Dominion, NOVEC, Rappahannock, ODEC, PPL, AEP, Duquesne, FirstEnergy, Exelon, Dayton AES, Duke and PSEG. The meeting page exposes filenames but not a uniform machine-readable capacity table.

records.label: organized-market/regional footprint
records.notes: PJM filing materials describe 38.9 GW of large-load adjustments concentrated in the Dominion, AEP, ComEd and PPL zones. Forecast/adjustment aggregate; not a unique facility population.

records.label: organized-market/regional footprint
records.notes: MidAmerican's March 2026 stakeholder feedback cites 35 of 46 proposed load-addition EPR projects, totaling 19,777 MW of 20,105.6 MW, as meeting a proposed >=75 MW definition. This is a stakeholder interpretation of an EPR statistics presentation, not a second queue population.

records.label: utility/regional footprint
records.notes: CAISO's current Public Queue Report is a full active/completed/withdrawn interconnection report. The 2026-09-26 report exposed 181 pages in the current public document, with queue position, project name, study process, project type, MW totals, county/state, utility, PTO region, POI/station/line and date/status fields. The registry currently keeps CAISO Cluster 15 rows in the core and a historical cluster series separately; this source record is the direct lead for full row-level refresh.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: Approximately 70,000 MW of large-load DP Requests were advancing through Dominion's queue as of Dec. 31, 2025. This aggregate can overlap PJM and is not converted to facility rows. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: ComEd presentation states 16 GW of highly probable large-load interconnection requests for 2026. This is utility-level pipeline evidence and may overlap PJM. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: SRP reported 80 projects above 10 MW totaling 15,308 MW; 52 were data center projects totaling 14,140 MW. Outside the nine-market core geography. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: PGE reported five data center customer contracts executed in 2025 and the first part of 2026 totaling 430 MW. Outside the nine-market core geography. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.provider: Georgia Public Service Commission / Georgia Power
records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: PSC states 9,985 MW of new generation was certified, with approximately 80% expected to power data centers. This is generation-side planning evidence, not a unique data-center load total. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: River Bend initial utility capacity is 330 MW to support 245 MW of critical IT load; campus has potential to scale to 1,000 MW utility capacity. MISO geography; possible overlap must be resolved before any additive accounting. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: DEQ reports 72 operating data centers in Loudoun County; its topics page also identifies nine more in planning. Permit inventory provides identity and regulatory provenance but not a uniform facility MW total. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: PGE reports 1.7 GW of additional incremental large-load requests through 2028 and 2032. This overlaps the separately reported executed 430 MW contracts and is therefore non-additive. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.provider: Georgia Public Service Commission / Georgia Power
records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: PSC filing #228337 is a Large Load Contract Summary dated Sept. 8, 2026 and includes a public ZIP attachment. The filing is retained as a direct source lead for contract-level extraction; values are not transcribed here because the attachment is a ZIP container and was not treated as machine-readable facility data. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: Exelon presentation describes 18 GW of commitments with customer protections. This broader footprint measure is distinct from, but overlaps, the 16 GW ComEd high-probability pipeline measure and is not additive. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: APS reports an uncommitted queue of 19.0 GW for extra-large energy users. The page identifies data centers as a major source of this growth. This is outside the nine-market core and is an aggregate, not a unique facility list. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: AEP reported total contracted load growth through 2030 of 69 GW after adding six GW of signed load agreements in Q2 2026. Agreements include hyperscalers, data centers and industrial customers. This footprint overlaps PJM/ERCOT/SPP. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: AEP's 2026 Impact Report states AEP Ohio anticipates approximately 12 GW of new contracted load across its service territory between 2026 and 2030. This overlaps PJM and the broader AEP footprint. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.provider: AEP Ohio / SB Energy / U.S. DOE
records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: AEP's 2026 Impact Report identifies a planned 10 GW data-center campus at the former Piketon gaseous diffusion plant, with new 765 kV transmission infrastructure and power expected to begin flowing in 2029. It is not converted into the core PJM table without an exact queue match. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: Ameren Missouri states its revised Preferred Resource Plan is designed to provide for up to 2 GW of new energy demand by 2032, while its Powering Missouri Growth plan targets large new enterprises including data centers. This is a planning envelope, not a unique queue. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.provider: Bonneville Power Administration / Watt Street secondary normalization
records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: Watt Street's public Load Ledger reports 457 BPA large-load requests totaling 72.4 GW as of 2026-09-22. This is a secondary normalization of public transmission-provider queues, not a BPA-issued aggregate. It is outside the nine-market core and is not added to core totals. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: Illinois ICC material records ComEd at more than 75 large demand projects with requested demand of 28,000 MW; at least 50 were expected to take 138 kV or higher service. This is an aggregate utility pipeline and may overlap the 16 GW later high-probability measure. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: Secondary public cross-reference reports 24 Idaho Power large-load requests totaling about 307 MW. This utility population is outside the nine-market core geography and is not added to core totals. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: PJM large-load workshop reports annual committed data-center capacity/participant counts. 2024/2025 delivery year: 47 participants and 243 MW Summer ICAP. Prior series in the same document: 2014/15 80 participants/179 MW; 2015/16 96/234; 2016/17 48/113; 2017/18 34/200; 2018/19 48/264; 2019/20 56/287; 2020/21 57/309; 2021/22 61/334; 2022/23 61/315; 2023/24 52/293. This is a historical market-participation series, not a facility queue. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.

records.label: regional evidence footprint
records.notes: ERCOT public presentation reports 410,618 MW of actual/projected large loads through 2030 as of March 26, 2026, with 355,830 MW (87.6%) shown as Data Center type. This is an aggregate status/forecast pipeline and is not added to the row-level 714-record generator-side registry. Geographic display is a regional footprint only; it is not a facility address.
